name: Describable Textures Dataset (DTD)
license_note: The official page states the data is made available to the computer vision community for research purposes. Images were collected from Google and Flickr; redistribution/commercial use should be treated cautiously.

name: Fashionpedia
data_type: fashion ontology, segmentation masks, localized attributes
scale: 48,825 images; 27 main apparel categories; 19 apparel parts; 294 attributes
license_note: Annotations and ontology are licensed under CC BY 4.0, but Fashionpedia states that it does not own the image copyrights; image use must follow the original image-source terms.
platform_use: safe to model as ontology/annotation source; image ingestion requires source-level rights review

name: DeepFashion
data_type: large-scale fashion images with categories, attributes, landmarks and retrieval pairs
license_note: The official agreement states non-commercial research purposes only and prohibits copying, publishing, distributing, selling or exploiting images/derived data for commercial purposes.
platform_use: research-only baseline; do not include raw images in redistributable demo

name: DeepFashion2

scale: 491K images; 801K clothing items; 13 categories; masks, landmarks, boxes

name: 의친왕가 복식 (Royal Attire of Prince Ui-chin's Household)
data_type: Korean National Intangible Cultural Heritage costume set — designation record and descriptive text only; no images ingested
scale: 6 items / 7 pieces (원삼, 당의, 스란치마, 노리개, 화관, 궁녀 대대 x2); designated 2025-02-26; held by 경운박물관 (Gyeongwun Museum); issuing authority 국가유산청 (Korea Heritage Service)
best_for: royal court costume vs. folk textile (江西夏布) contrast
worked example for this platform's rights-gate / evidence-authenticity workflow
license_note: Item detail page (digital.khs.go.kr) shows no explicit license or download terms. The related 국립무형유산원_국가무형문화재 현황 open API (data.go.kr dataset 15028215) is dual-licensed under 공공누리 제1유형 (source attribution required) and CCL, with a third-party-rights caveat — text metadata (name, designation year, field, region, holder) is reusable with attribution, but item photographs may carry separate rights held by the owning museum and must not be assumed freely reusable.
platform_use: citation-only comparison case entered manually from the public detail page; no images or files ingested, no API key obtained yet; if a data.go.kr API key is issued later, structured text metadata may be pulled via the open API and marked source_file_present: true, while any images stay source_file_present: false pending direct rights clearance from 경운박물관/국가유산청

name: 한산모시짜기 (Hansan Ramie Weaving)

scale: designated 1967-01-16; region 충청남도 서천군 (Seocheon, Chungcheongnam-do); documented process covers ramie stalk harvest, fiber splitting, and hand-loom weaving of summer cloth
best_for: closest direct comparison case to 江西夏布 — both are traditional bast-fiber (ramie/hemp) hand-weaving crafts
cross-national process comparison: raw fiber harvest → fiber preparation → hand-weaving
reference for how another country documents a living ramie-weaving ICH craft

platform_use: citation-only comparison case entered manually from the public detail page; no images or files ingested, no API key obtained yet — same integration path as PUB-KHS-UICHINWANG-005 if an API key is later issued

name: Cooper Hewitt, Smithsonian Design Museum — Japanese hemp/bast-fiber katagami stencils and umakake textile (CC0)
data_type: real CC0 collection images ingested into the platform (not citation-only) — 2 dye-resist paper stencils (katagami, hemp-leaf motif) + 1 woven bast-fiber horse-cover cloth (umakake), 8 images total
scale: 3 objects (chndm_1959-150-2, chndm_1976-103-105, chndm_2001-2-1) / 8 images; verified via api.si.edu with media_usage=CC0 on each record; downloaded and byte-for-byte SHA-256 recomputed (2026-07-10)
best_for: process-adjacent bast-fiber textile comparison for 江西夏布
the only fully-passing (Rights Gate = pass) real evidence-verified dataset in this platform (the author's own P12 KG data is conditional pending cultural-sensitivity review)
demonstrating the CC0 image-ingestion path end-to-end
license_note: Confirmed CC0 (public domain dedication) via Smithsonian Open Access API media_usage field for these 3 specific records, verified by direct API fetch (2026-07-10) — not assumed from institution-level marketing language.
platform_use: images physically copied into data/public_dataset_sources/chndm_hemp_textile_jp/ and registered with real sha256 in dataset_manifest.json/evidence_manifest.json/sample_manifest.json/checksum_manifest.json; important limitation: these are Japanese collection items, not Chinese 苎麻 or Korean 모시 — position as an independent process-adjacent comparison set, not a substitute for JXICH-XB-001
